name: Gods Presence
overview: Scripture reveals that God's presence is both a profound reality and a source of life and joy for those who seek Him wholeheartedly. From the early encounter in the garden where Adam and Eve experienced the weight of God's presence (Genesis 3:8), to God's promise of rest through His abiding presence (Exodus 33:14), the Bible shows that drawing near to God invites His nearness and cleansing (James 4:8). Believers find fullness of joy and eternal pleasures at God's right hand (Psalms 16:11) when they earnestly seek Him with all their heart (Jeremiah 29:13).
